RCSP-212.feature: Stock Count – Counted Quantity Rules & Summary
RCSP-212.description: Verify positive/zero/blank counted quantity rules, summary cards, validation, persistence, and active-only Add Item across Daily/Weekly/Monthly counts.

prerequisites: Active inventory items are available for the store

inactiveItem.note: Set to a real inactive item/PLU in QA to fully assert active-only dropdown
